name: research
description: Research workflow: scoping, exploration, synthesis, and conclusion for spikes, PoCs, architecture analysis, and technology evaluations.

steps.name: scoping
steps.description: Define research question, classify type, set scope boundaries, create task file
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Research question clearly defined with type classification, scope boundaries, and time box.
- [ ] Complete research task file content composed: frontmatter (branch: none, research_type, time_box, decision_for) and sections (Research Question, Scope, Findings, Recommendation).
- [ ] Delivered WRITE-FILE-FIRST for substantial files: write the markdown to team-management/tasks/r-<name>.md, then advance with an empty task_content — args: {"task": "r-<name>", "task_content": ""} (small files may pass the full markdown inline). Keep the args object small and emit the call bare.

steps.name: exploration
steps.description: Deep investigation using agents, AI providers, and codebase analysis
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] All investigation avenues have been explored.
- [ ] Key findings are documented via protocol_save_note().
- [ ] Enough evidence gathered to write a synthesis document.
- [ ] If exploration revealed the need for production code: discussed with the user whether to complete this research first and start a task protocol, or abort and switch.

steps.name: synthesis
steps.description: Write findings document, comparison matrices, decision records
steps.start:
Write up the research findings in the task file.

SCOPE OF THIS STEP: Documentation only. Write the findings, analysis, and recommendations into the task file's ## Findings and ## Recommendation sections.

1. Populate the ## Findings section with structured evidence from the exploration phase.
2. For evaluations: create comparison matrices or decision tables.
3. For architecture analysis: document trade-offs, constraints, and recommended approach.
4. For spikes/PoCs: document what was learned, what worked, what didn't.
5. Write the ## Recommendation section with a clear conclusion.
6. If follow-up implementation tasks are needed, list them under ### Follow-Up Tasks.
7. Update the work log with a synthesis summary entry.

Documentation mode allows editing task files and CLAUDE.md files but blocks source code edits.
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Findings document is complete with structured evidence, analysis, and a clear recommendation.
- [ ] Follow-up tasks are listed if applicable.
- [ ] Work log is updated.

steps.name: conclusion
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] User has reviewed findings and explicitly confirmed the research is complete.
On advance the engine automatically handles: archiving the research task file, updating issue status (if enabled), cleaning up task-scoped state, and clearing task state.
